mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_plan (user_id, name, start_date, end_date, schedule_time, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{scheduleTime}, #{enabled})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, start_date, end_date, schedule_time, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM training_plan WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY enabled DESC, start_date DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, user_id, name, start_date, end_date, schedule_time, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM training_plan WHERE enabled = TRUE AND end_date >= CURRENT_DATE
mapper.update: UPDATE training_plan SET name = #{name}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, schedule_time = #{scheduleTime}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{planId}
